title: VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a twice continuously differentiable function f:E→ℝ; nonconvex objectives are permitted. The initialization satisfies f(x0)−inf f≤Δ, without requiring an attained minimum.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean: spec.admissible, ContDiff and initial objective-gap conditions.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns only g(x,ξ), with fresh IID samples, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), and jointly measurable g. No function values, Hessians, sample reuse, or sample-level smoothness are supplied. All Params, including L, ρ, σ, Δ, ε, δ and x0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden. Cost counts individual gradient replies under a fixed call budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean: spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ², with σ≥0. Only a second-moment bound is imposed; bounded noise, exponential tails and higher moments are not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, variance integrability and variance bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and finite positive dimension d=finrankℝ(E).

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The population gradient is globally L-Lipschitz and its Hessian is globally ρ-Lipschitz in operator norm. Parameters satisfy L>0, ρ>0, Δ≥0, ε>0, 0<δ<1 and ρε≤L².
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, gradient and Hessian Lipschitz inequalities.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point x̂ satisfying ‖∇f(x̂)‖≤ε; the criterion uses the unsquared norm.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Both stationarity conditions hold jointly with probability at least 1−δ over algorithm randomness and the IID oracle samples.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/VarianceOnlySecondOrder.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability measure.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The same returned point must satisfy ⟨v,∇²f(x̂)v⟩≥−√(ρε)‖v‖² for every v∈E, equivalently λmin(∇²f(x̂))≥−√(ρε).

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Approximate second-order stationarity for smooth nonconvex optimization with Lipschitz Hessian and an IID unbiased bounded-variance gradient oracle is an established standard formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Variance-Only Second-Order Stationarity

We consider minimizing a possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on a positive-dimensional finite-dimensional real inner product space E. The function is twice continuously differentiable, with L-Lipschitz gradient and ρ-Lipschitz Hessian, where L,ρ>0. A given point x0∈E satisfies f(x0)−infx∈Ef(x)≤Δ, where Δ≥0. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients from independent, identically distributed samples, with variance at most σ2, where σ≥0. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1) satisfying ρε≤L2, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E satisfying ∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε and ⟨v,∇2f(x¯)v⟩≥−ρε∥v∥2 for every v∈E, with probability at least 1−δ.

The optimization problem is infx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. The Hessian ∇2f(x):E→E is the derivative of the gradient. The algorithm receives E, the measurable sample space Ω, L, ρ, σ, Δ, ε, δ, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness). The function f belongs to C2(E;R), and, for every x,y∈E, ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,∥∇2f(x)−∇2f(y)∥op≤ρ∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Initial objective gap). The given starting point satisfies f(x0)−f(x)≤Δ,x∈E.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic gradient oracle). There are a probability measure ν on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent random variables with common law ν under a joint probability law Q on ΩN. At its kth query x∈E, the oracle returns g(x,ξk).

For every fixed x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥2 is integrable under ν, with Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2]≤σ2. Any algorithm randomness is independent of the sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the algorithm must return a measurable output x¯ such that P(∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε,⟨v,∇2f(x¯)v⟩≥−ρε∥v∥2for every v∈E)≥1−δ, where P is the joint law of the algorithm randomness and the sample sequence with law Q.

comparisonHtml:
On a real inner-product space of dimension d≥1, f∈C2 has L-Lipschitz gradient, ρ-Lipschitz Hessian, and f(x0)−inff≤Δ. Here L,ρ,ε>0, σ,Δ≥0, 0<δ<1, and ρε≤L2. Fresh IID samples have law p; the jointly measurable oracle satisfies ∫g(x,z)dp(z)=∇f(x) and ∫∥g(x,z)−∇f(x)∥2dp(z)≤σ2. The target is P{∥∇f(x)∥≤ε, ∇2f(x)⪰−ρεI}≥1−δ.

import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.VarianceOnlySecondOrder

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 < q.ρ ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 ≤ q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1 ∧
    q.ρ * q.ε ≤ q.L ^ 2 ∧ 0 < Module.finrank ℝ q.E
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (P0 : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (P0 : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    ContDiff ℝ 2 f ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y‖ ≤ q.ρ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, f q.x0 - f x ≤ q.Δ) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (g x) (P0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂(P0 : Measure _) = gradient f x) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2) (P0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂(P0 : Measure _) ≤ q.σ ^ 2)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - q.δ) ≤ (P : Measure _) {ω |
        ‖gradient f (output ω)‖ ≤ q.ε ∧
        ∀ v, -Real.sqrt (q.ρ * q.ε) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪v, fderiv ℝ (gradient f) (output ω) v⟫}

end LongTails.Setups.VarianceOnlySecondOrder
